title: Trying out my first game jam! Check out Ricochet Manor, my spooky pachinko roguelite.
author: SnooEpiphanies481
selftext:
[**https://w.run/hooterrovo/ricochet-manor**](https://w.run/hooterrovo/ricochet-manor)

**TL;DR:** I made a spooky pachinko roguelite inspired by Peggle and Peglin, except YOU play as the monsters trying to scare away trick-or-treaters! It's my first serious attempt at finishing and releasing a game, and I'm building it for a game jam. 🎃

Meet **Ricochet Manor**!

I flip the script on the monster game. You're the monster(s), and those bratty trick-or-treaters need to GO.

Bounce orbs around a pachinko-style board, hit pegs, and rack up enough **Fright** to scare them away. Along the way, you can upgrade your orbs, change how scoring works, and unlock achievements and cosmetics.

**A little backstory:**

I've been making games off and on since the RPG Maker 2000 days. I've bounced between Phaser, Panda3D, Pygame, GameMaker, PICO-8, LÖVE... you name it.

I even tried pursuing game development as a career, attending DeVry University before eventually going down the physics -> math -> data science rabbit hole.

But despite all those years of tinkering, I've never really taken a game all the way across the finish line.

Recently, incorporating AI into my coding workflow has helped me approach game development more seriously, and **Ricochet Manor is my attempt to finally change that.**

I'm definitely more of a programmer than an artist, so the SVG artwork is a work in progress (and probably my next big learning adventure).

I'd love for you to check it out, and I'd especially appreciate any feedback!

**P.S.** You might notice ads in the game. Monetization is actually one of the judging criteria for the game jam, so I've tried to implement them in a way that doesn't get too in the way of gameplay.

comments.author: PoopsMcScoots
comments.body:
Good concept.

But I’d lose the AI live action intro.

replies.author: SnooEpiphanies481
replies.body:
First, I appreciate your feedback, thank your for responding.

But, aw dang, I was pretty happy with it other than the quick cut at the beginning. I might edit that out, so that it just starts as the second cut of them stepping up the stairs. 

I'll admit, it was my very first hand at AI Video creation. I had the idea of the "narrative" of the commercial-like ad, and thought I'd run with it. 

I'll definitely be making a second version without it. 

How do you feel about the small clip at the end of the vampire playing on his phone then turning into bats?

replies.author: PoopsMcScoots
replies.body: I don’t have too strong of opinion about what the clip should be but I do know that if you share that live action AI stuff you’re gonna get pounded by luddites.

replies.author: SnooEpiphanies481
replies.body:
Oof. Good call thank you. This is great chopping that stuff out entirely.

I think this is a much stronger trailer.

The one suggestion I might make is I would lean into Halloween themed transitions.

Like a swarm of bats passing in front of the screen to show the next shot.

Or a spider dropping down.

Or Jacko lantern rolling up from the bottom.
